overlayEntry.notes: Measured on Ethereum mainnet at pinned block 25627271 (2026-07-27T22:55:23Z, hash 0x127eef50495f9167cb636d144fe2d23c718f4d2dad4a6245b191931e15a1eb85) via ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com; journaled in the wave-8 packet draft journal 2026-07-27-block-25627271.json. USP totalSupply() = 7,319,172.452884225; the issuer-documented Chainlink-compatible NAV oracle returned answer 1.115009 (6 decimals, updatedAt 2026-07-27T22:55:23Z). Piku's documentation describes a delta-neutral USD-TRY arbitrage leg (BMMF), DeFi allocations, and a stablecoin buffer, but publishes no reconciled hedge notionals or net delta, no exchange margin balances or maintenance requirements, and no insurance or loss-absorption fund, so all three sdn metrics are honestly unavailable; the reserve-backing page lists example strategy partners with TVL figures but no issuer-attested current weights, and no transparency API or reserve dashboard exists. venueAndCustody is graded limited under D3: the issuer itemizes its custody architecture (Fireblocks MPC operational layer plus Safe multisig treasury vaults) and publishes four exact backing-wallet addresses with per-wallet roles, corroborated by pinned on-chain reads confirming the addresses exist and hold small ETH gas balances. The grade does not go higher because the published wallets returned empty bytecode (EOAs, consistent with Fireblocks MPC externally-owned accounts) and Safe getThreshold()/getOwners() calls returned empty, so the docs' 'Safe multisig vault' claim is not demonstrated on-chain for the published cold wallet, and no custodian attestation or account-segregation filing exists. hedgeReconciliation, fundingBasisStress, marginAndLiquidation, unwindCapacity, and lossAbsorption are omitted (bounded-unknown): no itemized evidence exists for any of them.

lossAbsorptionShare.rationale: Searched the Piku risks-and-mitigations, reserve-backing, yield-management, and platform-fees documentation: no insurance fund, first-loss reserve, or other quantified loss-absorption pool is disclosed anywhere in the issuer's documentation set.

backingWallets.note: All four published backing wallets returned empty bytecode at the pinned block (externally owned accounts, consistent with the documented Fireblocks MPC operational model). Safe getThreshold()/getOwners() calls returned empty results, so the documentation's 'Safe (Gnosis Safe) multisig vault' claim for cold storage is not demonstrated on-chain for these published addresses. ERC-20 holdings were not exhaustively inventoried; DeBank links in the issuer disclosure provide a third-party portfolio view.
